listing.name: Syphon Filter 2 / Syphon Filter 2 Recompiled
listing.summary: Prepare the current upstream Syphon Filter 2 player from your own USA two-disc set and SCPH-1001 BIOS, then keep its launcher, saves and updates under your control.

steps.title: Download your system’s setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official kit into a separate writable folder and keep your working copy. Install Python 3. The current 0.2.0 kit uses the native Syphon_Filter_2_Recompiled setup program, replacing older SETUP.bat instructions; paths with spaces are supported. Setup can obtain upstream’s portable CMake/Ninja tool pack or use suitable tools already installed. Downloading, extracting and discovery do not run a helper, compiler or game. Windows, Linux and each Mac architecture have separate downloads; Mac executables are ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized. Follow the selected release’s platform instructions.

steps.title: Prepare both discs and your BIOS
steps.instruction: When ready, deliberately open the upstream setup program. Supply your own Syphon Filter 2 USA Disc 1 (SCUS-94451) and Disc 2 (SCUS-94492) as the supported Redump CUE/BIN set or CHD, plus your own 512 KiB SCPH-1001 BIOS with SHA-256 71af94d1e47a68c11e8fdb9f8368040601514a42a5a399cda48c7d3bff1e99d3. OpenBIOS is not supported by this kit. Reuse valid prepared choices; follow Generate & rebuild to finish the native player. Portcove does not run this upstream preparation for you.

steps.title: Add the finished player, then choose Play
steps.instruction: After setup succeeds, select Syphon_Filter_2_Recompiled.exe in build-release on Windows, or the native Syphon_Filter_2_Recompiled in build-release on Linux or Mac. Keep the complete prepared kit and use the player’s folder as its working directory. Choose a different actual output location if you deliberately configured one. Saving launch details never starts the game; Play is a separate action. Keep the rich launcher. In the current version, Disc 2 can be changed through the F1 menu even when a CHD verification warning remains in the launcher. The game reads progress from memory-card slot 1.

steps.title: Keep your working copy and data before updating
steps.instruction: You or upstream manage rebuilding and runtime updates. Close the player and preserve the complete working kit, actual saves/card paths, settings.toml, keybinds.ini, config.ini, mods with their installed packages and state, original discs/BIOS and any custom locations before changing versions. Current default cards, save states and game options live under build-release/saves; customized card or profile paths may be elsewhere. Keep older kits separately: upstream says v0.1.x cards/settings are not carried over, without establishing a safe migration. Do not copy an old generated cache or whole mods tree over a new runtime. Let the first session finish preparing optimized code. If the release’s known intro freeze occurs after early closure, follow its cache-only recovery for build-release/cache with the player closed; preserve saves and the working copy. Portcove does not back up, roll back, replace or delete these external files.
